duplication_audit.novel_axis: past-only BDS-motivated fixed embedding-independence contrast C3(epsilon)-C1(epsilon)^3 and its signed log ratio
duplication_audit.v29_adjacency: v29 computes a one-dimensional fixed-radius recurrence rate C1 plus line/topology RQA summaries. It neither constructs a three-dimensional delay embedding nor stores C3, so C3-C1^3 is not reconstructible from v29 outputs.
duplication_audit.distinction: The new information is the factorization failure between the m=3 correlation integral and the cube of the scalar integral under a fixed epsilon. It is adjacent to recurrence counting but not an RQA line statistic, recurrence plot topology, ordinal pattern, spectrum, causality score, or reuse of prior predictions.
duplication_audit.repository_negative_fingerprint: No executed P3 BDS, embedding-independence, correlation-integral factorization, C3-minus-C1-cubed, or signed correlation-integral ratio contract was found.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: v64, all prior candidate outputs, and official feedback are excluded from features, gates, fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: past-only hs/tp/hmax/wspd on the native context, linearly filled within the observed prefix and sampled on the fixed 20-minute grid
encoder.normalization: case-window median and 1.4826*MAD; constant paths map to zero
encoder.metric: Chebyshev maximum norm; exclude self-pairs; use all unordered-equivalent ordered pairs

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Broock, Scheinkman, Dechert, and LeBaron, A test for independence based on the correlation dimension, Econometric Reviews 15(3), 197-235 (1996)
primary_sources.use: correlation-integral independence-factorization motivation only; no P3 performance claim
